lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in roughly four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, though spatial arrangement is frequently obscured by dynamic caustic light patterns from the surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular blobs to form a grid-like arrangement, primarily visible in the mid-lateral section between the gills and the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition between high-luminance dorsal surfaces and shadowed ventral troughs.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple slender, elongated dark silhouettes (remoras) are visible clustered along the ventral boundary and the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
